payload.title: Harden public agent runtime integration
payload.description:
Purpose: provide stable, supported Tactus APIs for model setup, lifecycle telemetry, serialization, and prewarming so consumers do not replace private runtime methods.

Definition of Done:
- Agent configuration and lifecycle hooks are public and tested.
- LLM prewarming moves import/setup work outside interactive requests.
- Pydantic JSON serialization is native.
- Release artifacts and documentation are published with full CI green.
